line_items.reasoning: WFC revised NII guidance to the low end of the prior 1%-3% growth range, citing rate path uncertainty, weaker loan growth, and a 40-50 bps downward shift in the forward curve — falling short of the midpoint of their own prior guidance.
Diluted EPS grew 16% YoY to $1.39, driven by NII, fee income, and an 8% YoY reduction in diluted share count from buybacks, tracking ahead of the implicit EPS improvement trajectory guided for 2025.

ROTCE progress continues (net charge-off ratio improved, credit quality broadly stable), but the 15% sustainable ROTCE target remains a full-year aspiration with no explicit Q1 overshoot or undershoot reported against that path.

Noninterest expense declined 3% YoY in Q1, and the company absorbed the guided $650M-$700M seasonal personnel headwind while still delivering year-over-year expense reduction, tracking favorably vs. the ~$54.2B full-year expense target.
No specific Q1 capex figures were reported to contradict the planned ~$900M incremental technology and ~$900M other investment targets; efficiency savings continue to fund investments as guided.
